description:
Job Title: Tableau Developer
 Duration: 6 Months
 Location: San Ramon, CA
 Responsibilities Team is looking for Expert experience with Tableau - including building and developing reports in Tableau. Experience with SQL and Access. Knowledge of PG&E's SAP system is a plus. This is a new position within this team and they are looking for someone to come in and help them improve and automate the current reporting process. Most reports will be pulled from SAP into Tableau. BS in CS or Engineering 4+ years in IT environment Familiarity with C#, Javascript, DHTML, CSS, ASP .NET and VB.NET Familiarity with SQL Server 2005 administration and stored procedures 
 
 Qualifications: 
 • Experience in Customer Data Analysis, Predictive Analysis, Product and Price Analysis. 
 • Minimum five years of experience in developing queries, analytics, creating dashboards, and documenting technical design specification. 
 • Strong working experience in data warehousing and business intelligence technologies including Teradata, SAS and Tableau. 
 • Strong time management, analytical, and problem solving experience. 
 • Effective communication skills and large scale system implementation experience. 
 • Knowledge of Smargrid technology and regulatory processes is a definite plus. 
 Minimum Qualifications • BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Physics or related quantitative discipline.
